title.suggested: Allen spars with Jem Mace at Brady's Curriculum in Jersey City

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted a New York Herald account of a four-round sparring exhibition between Tom Allen and Jem Mace at Prof. Brady's Curriculum in Jersey City, before a large and excited crowd.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat. Supplement. Sunday Morning, June 19, 1870' - the Missouri Democrat, not yet the Globe-Democrat. Item is credited to the N. Y. Herald of the 11th.

facts.fact: Allen and Jem Mace sparred four rounds in a friendly exhibition at Prof. Brady's Curriculum in Jersey City; each was shown with his championship belt
places: Prof. Brady's Curriculum, Jersey City, New Jersey

facts.fact: Allen was described as soon to contest with Mike McCoole for the championship of America

notes: Exhibition date inferred from 'last evening' in the Herald of June 11. Crop could be trimmed to drop the Susie Raper item.
